   The stock market under President Trump gained more than 36% from the 2024 election through September 2, 2026, as corporate earnings growth supported stock prices.

   U.S. consumer spending remains resilient but more selective, while business investment continues to support revenue, profit margins and earnings.

   Fluid tariff policy, geopolitical conflict, slower hiring and rising federal debt remain the principal risks to the 2026 stock market outlook.
